cgu.objetText: These general terms of use (Terms) govern access to and use of the Tala DZ platform (taladz.com), hereinafter "the Platform". By creating an account or using the Platform, you unreservedly accept these Terms and the Privacy Policy.
cgu.accesText: Access to the Platform is free for visitors. Creating an account is free and open to people aged 13 and over. Professional accounts are subject to approval by our moderation team. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential.
cgu.contenuText: You retain the intellectual property of your content. By publishing on the Platform, you grant Tala DZ a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to display, distribute and promote your content within the Platform. Published content must comply with applicable laws and copyright, and must not contain any defamatory, discriminatory or unlawful statements. We reserve the right to moderate or remove any inappropriate content.
cgu.responsabiliteText: Tala DZ does its utmost to ensure the availability and security of the Platform, without guaranteeing uninterrupted operation. We cannot be held liable for content published by users. In the event of a dispute, Algerian law applies.
cgu.modificationText: We may amend these Terms at any time. Users will be informed by a notification on the Platform. Continued use after an amendment constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

privacy.responsableText: The controller of personal data is Tala DZ, available at taladz.com. For any question about the protection of your data, you can contact us at: contact@taladz.com.
privacy.donneesIntro: We only collect the data needed for the Platform to operate:
privacy.donneesIdentite: Identity data: last name, first name, email address (required at registration)
privacy.donneesOptionnelles: Optional data: date of birth, gender, phone, address, profile photo, biography
privacy.donneesPro: Professional data (if applicable): company, specialities, certifications, website
privacy.donneesNavigation: Browsing data: IP address (anonymised), pages viewed, device type
privacy.pasDeVente: Your personal information is never sold to third parties.
privacy.finaliteCompte: Account management and authentication — legal basis: performance of the contract (Terms)
privacy.finaliteContenu: Publishing and displaying your cultural content — legal basis: performance of the contract
privacy.finaliteStats: Anonymised visitor statistics — legal basis: legitimate interest
privacy.finaliteNewsletter: Sending the newsletter (only if you have opted in) — legal basis: consent, which can be withdrawn at any time via the link in every email or the "My data" section
privacy.finaliteSecurite: Platform security (abuse prevention) — legal basis: legitimate interest
privacy.conservationCompte: Account data: kept as long as your account is active
privacy.conservationSuppression: If your account is deleted: your personal data is erased and your public contributions are anonymised
privacy.conservationSauvegardes: Security backups: kept for 7 days; data from a deleted account disappears from them within that period
privacy.droitsIntro: In accordance with applicable legislation and the GDPR, you have the following rights:
privacy.droitAccesDesc: — view and export all your data from your profile
privacy.droitRectificationDesc: — edit your personal information at any time
privacy.droitSuppressionDesc: — delete your account and all your personal data
privacy.droitPortabiliteDesc: — export your data in a machine-readable format (JSON)
privacy.droitOppositionDesc: — manage your notification and privacy preferences
privacy.droitsExercice: To exercise your rights, go to the "My data" section of your profile (export, account deletion, newsletter) or contact us at contact@taladz.com.
privacy.soustraitantsIntro: To operate the Platform, we use the following services:
privacy.soustraitantCloudinary: Cloudinary — hosting of the images and media you publish (servers located outside Algeria)
privacy.soustraitantEmail: Email delivery provider (SMTP) — transactional emails and newsletter (your email address)
privacy.soustraitantOSM: OpenStreetMap / Nominatim — base maps and geocoding: your IP address is sent to their servers when a map is displayed
privacy.soustraitantUnsplash: Unsplash — some illustration images: your IP address is sent when they are displayed
privacy.soustraitantsPas: No personal data is sold, rented or transferred for commercial purposes. Fonts and icons are hosted by the Platform itself.
privacy.cookiesText: The Platform only uses cookies that are strictly necessary for it to work (authentication, language preference, CSRF security). No advertising or third-party tracking cookies are used.
privacy.reclamationText: If you believe that the processing of your data does not comply with the regulations, you can lodge a complaint with the data protection authority in your country (in France: CNIL — cnil.fr, in Algeria: ANPDP).

mentions.editeurText: Tala DZ — Collaborative platform promoting Algerian cultural heritage.
mentions.hebergeurText: The Platform is hosted on a secure dedicated VPS server (HTTPS, Let's Encrypt certificate).
mentions.dpoText: For any question about the protection of your personal data, you can contact our data protection officer at: contact@taladz.com.
